scope: Captured from an isolated owned C-Gate 3.4 daemon and fake PCI. No house, alarm panel, Docker, or live C-Bus network was used. Payloads exclude the optional checksum and confirmation code.

validated_boundaries.application: Security application 208 (0xD0); decimal, $D0, and selected-project paths
validated_boundaries.arm_mode: case-insensitive away, night, day, vacation, highest
validated_boundaries.key: signed 32-bit integer; native encoder maps values outside 0..255 to FF; $ hex is accepted
validated_boundaries.display_message: zero or one token; C-Gate escape decoding; at most 17 encoded bytes despite stale help claiming 18
validated_boundaries.zone: published/decompiled range 1..127; native's out-of-range array failure is not emulated

negative_examples.response: 405 Parameter out of range: 254/208 (bad arm mode)
405 Parameter out of range: 254/208 (bad tamper mode)
405 Parameter out of range: 254/208 (Message too long)
405 Parameter out of range: 254/208 (Bad escaped character)
405 Parameter out of range: 254/208 (For input string: "GG")

native_bug_closed: C-Gate returned 500 for REQUEST_ZONE_NAME -1 and 128 because its decoder indexes a fixed zone array. cmqttd validates 1..127 before PCI I/O and returns a parameter error.

inbound_decoder.evidence: Retained CBusSecurityApplication.class plus C-Gate Manual 3.4 section 4.7.2.3; no physical alarm-panel traffic
inbound_decoder.command_opcodes: 0xA0..0xA7; the decoder accepts display-message prefix E1..F3 (0..18 data bytes), while the command parser emits only E1..F2 because it caps encoded input at 17 bytes
inbound_decoder.status_report_1: 0xAC 0x8E, arm/tamper/panic, then 32 two-bit zone states packed four per byte, high pair first
inbound_decoder.status_report_2: 0xAD 0x8F, then 48 two-bit zone states packed four per byte, high pair first

acceptance_boundary: A 200 response establishes PCI-confirmed broadcast delivery only. Alarm-panel acceptance, durable state, and MQTT security entities are not claimed. Bridged Security routing was not evidenced and remains unsupported.
